desc: Cruel Barb: Edwin VanCleef's famous sword from World of Warcraft: a wicked one-handed sword with a jagged barbed dark steel blade and a dark red wrapped hilt
Strike of the Hydra: Aku'mai's famous two-handed sword from World of Warcraft: a long two-handed sword with a wavy deep teal-blue blade patterned like hydra scales and a serpent-head crossguard
Illusionary Rod: Arcanist Doan's famous staff from World of Warcraft: a tall mage's staff of dark wood and gold with a glowing violet-pink crystal orb held in curling prongs at the top
Ravager: Herod's famous two-handed axe from World of Warcraft: a huge two-handed battle axe with a broad curved dark steel blade, red trim and spikes, resting on the shoulder

Dirgehammer's Beard: Durgen Dirgehammer, a Dark Iron dwarf: a big braided red beard hanging down, covering the mouth and chin (covering the tusks), red hair, and round goggles with red lenses pushed up on the brow, the eyes uncovered
Cruel Barb: Edwin VanCleef's famous sword from World of Warcraft: a wicked one-handed sword with a jagged barbed dark steel blade and a dark red wrapped hilt
Ravager: Herod's famous two-handed axe from World of Warcraft: a huge two-handed battle axe with a broad curved dark steel blade, red trim and spikes
Searing Blade Robe: a dark red Searing Blade cultist robe with black trim, a rope belt and small fel green glowing runes at the hem
Scarlet Arcanist Robe: a red Scarlet Crusade wizard robe with gold trim, gold stars and a blue sash
Emerald Dragonscale: deep dark emerald dragonscale armour with dark teal highlights and leafy vines, from the Emerald Dream
Drakkisath's Scale Mail: black dragonscale armour with dark red scales and red glowing seams, General Drakkisath's
Ogre King's Furs: the Gordok ogre king's purple royal cloak with a thick fur collar, crude gold chains and a big gold belt buckle, King Gordok's
Necromancer Robes: black necromancer robes with dark purple trim, bone clasps and glowing purple runes, Darkmaster Gandling's
Death Knight Plate: Baron Rivendare's dark grey death knight plate with skull pauldrons and pale blue glowing trim
Barrowmoon Robe: a deep violet druid of the moon robe with pale lavender moon and leaf patterns and silver trim
Wild Bark Armor: armour of living tree bark with green leaves and moss growing on it, a vine belt

Dirgehammer's Harness: Durgen Dirgehammer's dark grey iron armour: a heavy harness of big iron rings and chain links over the bare chest, studded leather straps, a wide iron belt with a big ring buckle, and chunky oversized dark iron bracers wrapping the whole forearms

Cruel Barb: Edwin VanCleef's famous sword from World of Warcraft: a one-handed scimitar with a smooth curved pale lavender-steel blade widening towards the tip, a hooked barb notch just below the point, a grey metal cross guard with flared spiked ends and a small red gem in the middle, a grey grip and a round pommel
Strike of the Hydra: Aku'mai's famous two-handed sword from World of Warcraft: a long two-handed sword with a wavy deep teal-blue blade patterned like hydra scales and a serpent-head crossguard
Illusionary Rod: Arcanist Doan's famous staff from World of Warcraft: a tall mage's staff of dark wood and gold with a glowing violet-pink crystal orb held in curling prongs at the top
Ravager: Herod's famous two-handed axe from World of Warcraft: a huge two-handed battle axe with a broad curved dark steel blade, red trim and spikes
Cursed Felblade: Taragaman the Hungerer's sword from World of Warcraft: a dark demon sword with a jagged cursed blade, red demonic runes and a faint sickly glow, a horned hilt
Venomstrike: Lord Serpentis's famous bow from World of Warcraft: a curved bow shaped like a serpent, a snake head at each tip, dark brown wood with teal scales, venom dripping
Meteor Shard: Archmage Arugal's dagger from World of Warcraft: a dagger whose blade is a jagged glowing orange-red meteor rock shard, with a dark iron hilt
Debt Collector: Bazil Thredd's sword from World of Warcraft: a Defias scimitar with a curved pale steel blade and a red-wrapped hilt

Electromagnetic Gigaflux Reactivator: Mekgineer Thermaplugg's famous helmet from World of Warcraft: a brass gnome engineering helmet with big glowing lens goggles, coils, a crackling antenna and little lightning sparks, open-faced

Heart of Agamaggan: Charlga Razorflank's famous shield from World of Warcraft: a round shield made of a great boar's hide stretched over wood, with a boar skull and tusks in the middle and thorny bristles round the rim
Torturing Poker: the Scarlet Monastery graveyard's dagger from World of Warcraft: a long iron poker-like dagger with a glowing red-hot tip
Whitemane's Chapeau: High Inquisitor Whitemane's famous hat from World of Warcraft: a tall red and white Scarlet Crusade priest's hat with gold trim and a gold Scarlet emblem on the front
Icemetal Barbute: Amnennar the Coldbringer's helmet from World of Warcraft: a pale blue-grey icy plate barbute helm rimmed with frost and little icicles, its face opening wide so the whole face shows
Stoneslayer: Archaedas's two-handed sword from World of Warcraft: a huge two-handed sword with a broad blade of carved grey titan stone with steel edges and glowing blue runes

Jang'thraze the Protector: Chief Ukorz Sandscalp's sword from World of Warcraft, one half of Sul'thraze: a troll sword with a curved gold blade with jagged teeth and dark jade inlays on one edge and a bone hilt
Sang'thraze the Deflector: Antu'sul's sword from World of Warcraft, the other half of Sul'thraze: a troll sword with a curved red-gold blade with jagged teeth on one edge and a bone hilt

Sul'thraze the Lasher: the legendary troll sword from World of Warcraft, Jang'thraze and Sang'thraze joined into one: a huge two-handed troll sword with a long curved jagged blade glowing green and red, carved troll runes and a bone and gold hilt
Blade of Eternal Darkness: Princess Theradras's famous dagger from World of Warcraft: a long dark dagger with a black blade wreathed in purple-black shadow and a purple gem in the hilt
Dragon's Call: the Shade of Eranikus's famous sword from World of Warcraft: a one-handed sword with a curved dark emerald blade, a dragon-head crossguard with wings and a glowing gem
Ironfoe: Emperor Dagran Thaurissan's famous mace from World of Warcraft: a heavy dwarven war mace with a big flanged dark iron head with a glowing molten orange core and gold bands on the handle
Fist of Omokk: Highlord Omokk's two-handed mace from World of Warcraft: a huge crude ogre maul with a stone-and-iron head shaped like a big fist, spiked
Draconian Deflector: General Drakkisath's shield from World of Warcraft: a big black dragonscale shield shaped like a dragon's head with red glowing eyes and horns
Dal'Rend's Sacred Charge: Rend Blackhand's famous sword from World of Warcraft: an orcish sword with a broad curved steel blade, a red and black Blackrock hilt with a tusk crossguard

Dal'Rend's Tribal Guardian: the matching off-hand sword of Rend Blackhand's pair from World of Warcraft: a slightly smaller orcish sword with a curved steel blade and a red and black Blackrock hilt with a tusk crossguard

Dal'Rend's Arms: Rend Blackhand's famous pair of orcish swords from World of Warcraft, Sacred Charge and Tribal Guardian, one held in each fist, their red and black Blackrock hilts with tusk crossguards
Ring of Demonic Potency: Alzzin the Wildshaper's ring from World of Warcraft: a big dark iron demonic ring with a glowing purple gem and purple wisps
Mind Carver: Prince Tortheldrin's sword from World of Warcraft: an elegant curved Highborne elven sword with a silver blade with violet arcane runes and a gold hilt
Crown of the Ogre King: King Gordok's famous crown from World of Warcraft: a crude heavy ogre king's crown of dented gold with big spikes and chunky red gems
Headmaster's Charge: Darkmaster Gandling's famous staff from World of Warcraft: a tall dark necromancer's staff topped with a horned skull with glowing purple eyes and a purple crystal
Book of the Dead: Balnazzar's book from World of Warcraft: a heavy black tome bound in cracked dark leather with a skull on the cover and iron corners, eerie purple glow

Runeblade of Baron Rivendare: Baron Rivendare's famous two-handed sword from World of Warcraft: a long death knight runeblade of dark saronite steel with pale blue glowing runes and a skull crossguard
Deathbringer: Onyxia's famous axe from World of Warcraft: a one-handed axe with a wide jagged black blade crackling with dark shadow energy and a skull on the haft
Durgen's Crescent Axe: Durgen Dirgehammer's axe: a Dark Iron dwarf axe with a big crescent moon shaped dark iron blade and red-hot glowing runes
Mirror of Rath'mael: Rath'mael's off-hand mirror: an ornate hand mirror framed in dark iron and bone, its glass glowing cold pale blue
Golemsight Long Gun: the Relic Guardian's rifle: a long dwarven rifle of bronze and carved stone with a glowing deep teal scope lens
